title: Reputation Effects with Endogenous Records
title_zh: 内生记录下的声誉效应
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: I study how the ability to erase records affects patient players’ returns from building reputations. In my model, a patient seller interacts with a sequence of myopic consumers. The seller is either an honest type who always exerts effort and never erases any records, or an opportunistic type who may shirk and can also erase his past actions at a low cost. I show that the seller has an incentive to exert effort until he has a long enough good record, after which his continuation value exceeds his commitment payoff. However, once the seller is sufficiently long-lived, his equilibrium payoff must be close to his minmax value.
abstract_zh: 本文研究记录删除能力如何影响耐心玩家通过建立声誉获得的回报。在模型中，一位耐心卖家与一系列短视消费者进行互动。卖家分为两种类型：一种是始终付出努力且从不删除任何记录的诚实型，另一种是可能偷懒且能以低成本删除过往行为的投机型。研究表明，卖家有动力持续付出努力，直至其积累足够长的良好记录，此时其延续价值将超过承诺收益。然而，一旦卖家存续时间足够长，其均衡收益必然趋近于最小最大值。

title: The AI investment race
official: 官方在线 2026-07-14 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Focus Exuberance about new technologies often brings about investment booms. The race among firms to capture a share of the revenues can result in excessive investment that makes the boom prone to a disruptive end. The boom-bust cycle recurs across history, from the canal and railway manias of the 19th century to the dotcom boom of the 1990s. The current artificial intelligence (AI) build-out ranks among the largest technology-driven investment booms in US history. Could it share the same fate as prior episodes?
abstract_zh: 对新技术的狂热关注常常引发投资热潮。企业为争夺收入份额而展开的竞争可能导致过度投资，使热潮容易以破坏性结局收场。从19世纪的运河与铁路狂热到20世纪90年代的互联网泡沫，繁荣-萧条周期在历史上反复出现。当前的人工智能基础设施建设规模，堪称美国历史上规模最大的技术驱动型投资热潮之一。它是否会重蹈此前历次热潮的覆辙？
